population.sampling: Simple random sample of 5,000 of 3,487,175 DiaObjects (the lowest md5 of the decimal diaObjectId), with every delivered DiaSource of each. Sky density and per-date counts are complete; this layer is not, so it is never aggregated into population counts.

fields.label: diaObjectId
fields.description: Derived DIA grouping key (pred.is_sso false AND diaObjectId > 0); int64 carried as a decimal string.

fields.label: RA (ICRS)
fields.description: Unit-vector mean of delivered DiaSource positions, rounded to 1e-5 deg.

fields.label: Dec (ICRS)
fields.description: Unit-vector mean of delivered DiaSource positions, rounded to 1e-5 deg.

fields.label: Delivered DiaSources
fields.description: Delivered DiaSource rows in this basis; not lifetime detections.
